observations: Photo 0 shows two retail boxes for a 'PORODO LIFESTYLE HANDHELD MINI PRESS STEAM IRON'.
The boxes are white with gold and black accents, displaying a graphic of the handheld iron.
Text on the boxes specifies '1000W POWERFUL STEAM' and 'FAST PREHEAT'.
The actual device is not visible outside of the packaging.
The boxes show some minor denting and shelf wear on the corners.
The background suggests a retail or storage environment with other electronics boxes visible.
A watermark for 'IFEX ACCESSORIES' on Jiji is present across the center.
